whenToUse: Plan × feature detail tables on a pricing page.
A two-column comparison of your product vs an alternative approach.
avoidWhen: Plan summary cards — use Pricing table first; put the full matrix below.
App data — use Table or Data Table.
a11y: A real table with caption and scoped headers; included/excluded marks have text alternatives.
On phones it scrolls horizontally in a labelled region, keeping the feature column sticky.
